function.name: ProductSearch_execute
function.description: Performs a search for products in the database based on specified criteria, such as keywords and filters, and returns a list of matching products. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

keywords.description: The search terms used to find products, separated by spaces.

category.description: The category to filter the search results. If no category is specified, all categories will be included in the search.

price_range.description: A price range to narrow down the search results, specified as a string in the format 'min-max' where min and max are prices in USD.

sort_order.description: The order in which the search results are sorted. Choose 'asc' for ascending or 'desc' for descending order.

in_stock.description: A flag to filter search results to only include products that are in stock. Set to true to include only in-stock items.

message.content:
It depends! Here’s a quick checklist you might use:

| Question | Why it matters |
|----------|----------------|
| **Occasion** (formal event vs casual outing) | Black shirts look sharp at business meetings or dinner parties, while they’re also great for laid‑back weekends. |
| **Outfit pairing** – What pants/jeans do you plan to wear? | Pairing black with dark denim gives an “all‑black” vibe; mixing with lighter colors creates contrast. |
| **Color harmony** – Do you want something bold or subtle? | Black works well under bright accessories (e.g., red tie), but may clash with very warm tones unless balanced carefully. |
| **Skin tone & hair colour** | Darker shades tend to flatter cooler skin undertones; warmer undertones often pair better with richer hues like burgundy or olive. |
| **Personal preference** – How comfortable does black feel? | Some people love the sleekness of black; others prefer brighter fabrics for everyday comfort. |

If you let me know what kind of setting you’ll be dressing for—or even just your usual wardrobe staples—I could give more tailored tips. But generally speaking, a clean black shirt is versatile enough to work anywhere from office hours to after‑hours events—just make sure the rest of your ensemble balances out its intensity.
